raw_requirements: Students shall be able to view the courses being offered and the number of seats still available in each course.
Students shall be able to view course details including the course title, instructor, class time, capacity, and remaining seats.
Students shall be able to register for a course that has a seat available.
The system shall tell a student whether a registration succeeded and shall give a reason when it did not succeed.
The system shall not register the same student for the same course more than once.
The system shall not accept registrations beyond the capacity of a course.
Students shall be able to view the courses for which they are registered.
Students shall be able to cancel their own registration during the registration period.
When a registration is cancelled, the corresponding seat shall become available again.
If several students attempt to take the last available seat at the same time, the system shall not exceed the course capacity.
If one student submits several registration attempts for the same course at the same time, the system shall retain only one registration.
Course and registration information shall not be lost when the application or its server is restarted.
The application shall be deployable as a container running on Linux virtual machines.
Authoritative course registration state shall not be kept only in the local storage of one application instance, so that a replacement instance can process subsequent requests.
The system that stores course registration information shall not be directly accessible from the Internet.
Environment-specific configuration and secrets shall be supplied when the service is run rather than included in the application artifact.
The operating environment shall be able to determine automatically whether an application instance is ready to process requests.
The cloud environment required by the service shall be reproducibly created and removed from a version-controlled infrastructure definition.
For the initial pilot, a temporary service interruption caused by an application server failure is acceptable.
resource_constraints_text: The university will pilot the service in the AWS Seoul Region (ap-northeast-2), and the monthly cloud budget must not exceed 500 USD. The fixed research scope is Docker on Linux virtual machines with Terraform and temporary HTTP endpoints. HTTPS, TLS certificates, and domain management are outside this pilot. The pilot may not use a managed database service, Kubernetes, or serverless compute and must use synthetic data instead of real personal data. Recovery from a data-storage server failure is outside this pilot.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: A person enrolled at the institution who can view the catalog of courses, see detailed information for each course, register for courses that have available seats, receive confirmation or error messages about registration attempts, view the list of courses they are enrolled in, and cancel their own registrations during the allowed registration period.

use_cases.name: View course catalog
use_cases.goal: See the list of courses that are being offered together with the number of seats still available and the detailed information for each course so the student can decide which courses to register for.

use_cases.name: Register for a course
use_cases.goal: Enroll in a selected course that has an available seat and receive immediate feedback about the success or failure of the registration.

use_cases.name: View enrolled courses
use_cases.goal: Display the set of courses for which the student is currently registered.

use_cases.name: Cancel course registration
use_cases.goal: Withdraw from a previously registered course during the allowed registration period and make the released seat available for other students.

use_case_specs.name: View course catalog
preconditions: Student has an active authenticated session
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a request to view the course catalog

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests the course catalog
System presents the list of offered courses together with the number of seats still available for each course
Student selects a course from the list to view its details
System presents the selected course's title, instructor, class time, capacity, and remaining seats

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: System cannot retrieve the list of offered courses

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the course catalog is currently unavailable

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: System cannot retrieve instructor information for the selected course

handling_steps.sentence: System provides the available details (title, class time, capacity, remaining seats) and notes that instructor information is unavailable

extensions.label: 4b
extensions.condition: Selected course is no longer offered in the catalog

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the selected course is no longer available

success_guarantee: Student has seen the complete list of offered courses with current seat availability and has received the full details of the selected course
minimal_guarantee: No enrollment data is modified during the view operation
All information presented to the student is limited to courses the student is authorized to view
System maintains confidentiality of student credentials throughout the interaction

use_case_specs.name: Register for a course
preconditions: Student is enrolled at the institution and has access to the course catalog
use_case_specs.trigger: Student requests registration for a selected course

main_scenario.sentence: Student selects a course and submits a registration request
System verifies that the student is not already registered for the course and that at least one seat is available
System creates a registration entry for the student in the course
System informs the student that registration succeeded

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: the selected course has no available seats

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that registration failed because the course is full

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: the student is already registered for the selected course

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that registration failed because they are already enrolled

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: concurrent registration attempts would exceed the course capacity

handling_steps.sentence: System retains only one registration for the student and discards the others
System informs the student whose attempt was discarded that registration failed because the seat was taken by another request

success_guarantee: The student is enrolled in the selected course
A single registration record for the student and course exists
The course seat count reflects the new enrollment
The student receives a confirmation of successful registration
minimal_guarantee: No registration record is created for the student if the use case fails
The system does not exceed the course capacity
The system continues to enforce that a student cannot be registered for the same course more than once
All data retained by the system remains protected according to institutional policies

use_case_specs.name: View enrolled courses
preconditions: Student has an active authenticated session with the system
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a request to view current enrollments

main_scenario.sentence: Student initiates a request to view current enrollments
System retrieves the set of courses for which the student is registered
System presents the retrieved course set to the student

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: System cannot retrieve enrollment data

handling_steps.sentence: System notifies the student that enrollment information cannot be displayed due to a technical problem

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: Retrieved course set is empty

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that no courses are currently registered

success_guarantee: The student receives an accurate display of all courses for which they are currently registered
minimal_guarantee: The request does not modify enrollment data
The system maintains confidentiality of other students' enrollment information
Any error messages preserve system security

use_case_specs.name: Cancel course registration
preconditions: Student is authenticated to the system
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a cancellation request for a course they are enrolled in

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests cancellation of the selected course
System verifies that the student is registered for the selected course and that the registration period permits cancellation
System removes the student's registration for the course
System increments the available seat count for the course
System notifies the student that the cancellation succeeded

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: Student is not registered for the selected course

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that no registration exists for the selected course

extensions.label: 2b
extensions.condition: Registration period is closed

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the cancellation period has ended

extensions.label: 3a
extensions.condition: System encounters an error while removing the registration

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student of the error and suggests retrying later

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: System fails to update the seat availability

handling_steps.sentence: System attempts to retry the seat update
If the retry fails, System informs the student of the failure

success_guarantee: The student is no longer registered for the cancelled course
The seat previously occupied by the student is available for other students
The student receives confirmation that the cancellation succeeded
minimal_guarantee: No registration is removed if cancellation cannot be completed
Seat availability remains unchanged when cancellation fails
System state remains consistent and any partial changes are rolled back

class_diagram_puml:
@startuml
allowmixing
!theme plain
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

class CourseCatalogView <<Boundary>> {
  + requestCatalog(): void
  + selectCourse(courseId : String): void
  + viewCourseDetails(courseId : String): void
  + showCatalogUnavailable(): void
  + showCourseNoLongerAvailable(): void
  + displayCourseDetails(course : Course): void
}

class RegistrationForm <<Boundary>> {
  + submitRegistration(courseId : String): void
  + showRegistrationSuccess(): void
  + showCourseFullError(): void
  + showAlreadyRegisteredError(): void
  + showConcurrentRegistrationFailed(): void
}

class EnrolledCoursesView <<Boundary>> {
  + requestEnrolledCourses(): void
  + showEnrolledCourses(courses : List<Course>): void
  + showEnrollmentRetrievalError(): void
  + showNoEnrolledCourses(): void
}

class CancellationForm <<Boundary>> {
  + submitCancellation(courseId : String): void
  + showCancellationSuccess(): void
  + showNoRegistrationError(): void
  + showCancellationPeriodClosed(): void
  + showCancellationError(): void
  + showSeatUpdateFailed(): void
}

class CatalogController <<Control>> {
  + getCourseCatalog(): List<Course>
  + getCourseDetails(courseId : String): Course
}

class RegistrationController <<Control>> {
  + registerCourse(studentId : String, courseId : String): Registration
  + checkAvailability(courseId : String): boolean
  + checkAlreadyRegistered(studentId : String, courseId : String): boolean
}

class EnrolledCoursesController <<Control>> {
  + getEnrolledCourses(studentId : String): List<Course>
}

class CancellationController <<Control>> {
  + cancelRegistration(studentId : String, courseId : String): void
  + verifyCancellationAllowed(studentId : String, courseId : String): boolean
  + retrySeatUpdate(courseId : String): void
}

class Student <<Entity>> {
  - studentId : String
  - name : String
}

class Course <<Entity>> {
  - courseId : String
  - title : String
  - instructor : String
  - classTime : String
  - capacity : int
  - remainingSeats : int
}

class Registration <<Entity>> {
  - registrationId : String
  - studentId : String
  - courseId : String
  - registrationDate : String
}

CourseCatalogView ..> CatalogController
CatalogController ..> Course
RegistrationForm ..> RegistrationController
RegistrationController ..> Registration
RegistrationController ..> Course
RegistrationController ..> Student
EnrolledCoursesView ..> EnrolledCoursesController
EnrolledCoursesController ..> Registration
EnrolledCoursesController ..> Course
EnrolledCoursesController ..> Student
CancellationForm ..> CancellationController
CancellationController ..> Registration
CancellationController ..> Course
CancellationController ..> Student
Course "1" --> "*" Registration
Student "1" --> "*" Registration

@enduml
